content: Supabase docs (fetched 2026-10-12): Broadcast is the recommended method for scale and security; Postgres Changes authorizes every event per subscriber and processes on a single thread. Broadcast from DB via realtime.send(payload, event, topic, is_private) or realtime.broadcast_changes(topic, event, op, table, schema, new, old) in a trigger; private channels need RLS policies on realtime.messages (realtime.topic(), extension broadcast/presence), client config {private:true} and supabase.realtime.setAuth(). Policies cached per connection. Pro plan: 500 concurrent connections, 500 msg/s, 3000 KB broadcast payload. Private channels support broadcast replay.
